learning.m_hint: Computed only from the data on this computer. With a single user these are trends, not statistics: below 20 answers no conclusion is drawn.
learning.m_ab: Local A/B test: % of answers without lessons (0 = off)
learning.m_curator: Daily curator: propose archiving skills unused for 60 days (never deletes)
learning.m_ranker_hint: It learns which citation you open after each answer and reorders the sources of the next one. It only activates if it beats the search on a part of the data it did not train on.
learning.rk_need: It needs more data: {0} answers with a click (you have {1} clicks).
learning.rk_beat: It beats the search on the test: AUC {0} vs {1}.
learning.rk_nobeat: It does not beat the search (AUC {0} vs {1}): still inactive.
learning.m_low: too little signal yet (fewer than {0} answers)
learning.s_lessons_effect_helps: Answers with lessons get fewer 👎 ({0} vs {1} per 100).
learning.s_lessons_effect_hurts: Answers with lessons get more 👎 ({0} vs {1} per 100): review your lessons.
learning.s_lessons_effect_no_difference: With and without lessons, 👎 are similar ({0} vs {1}).
learning.s_lessons_effect_low_signal: Effect of lessons: too little signal yet.
learning.s_ab_effect_helps: A/B: the lessons group does better ({0} vs {1} 👎 per 100).
learning.s_ab_effect_hurts: A/B: the no-lessons group does better ({0} vs {1} 👎 per 100).
learning.s_lessons_to_review: {0} active lessons collect 👎: review them in "What I have learned".
learning.s_unused_skills: {0} skills unused for 60 days: you can propose archiving them.
learning.d_skill_delta: With/without skill difference: needs live evals (not available yet).
learning.d_sessions: Sessions: {0} % of tasks accepted on the first try (n={1})
learning.d_sessions_na: Sessions: not available in this version.
learning.evals_hint: Offline evaluation cases (recorded answers, no network, no keys). This page only shows them: it runs nothing and calls no model.
learning.evals_none: This installation does not include the evaluation cases (they only ship with the source code). Nothing to show.
learning.evals_no_harness: Cases found in {0}. The harness that runs them is not in this version yet; this page only reads the files.
learning.evals_harness: Cases in {0}. To run them (offline, no keys) use the terminal:
learning.evals_no_runs: No local runs (live evals arrive in a later version).
learning.sp_hint: The agent only proposes. Nothing is written to your vault until you approve, and skills are only proposed when you click a button. Unused skills are never deleted: at most, archiving is proposed.
learning.sp_blocked: Blocked by the linter: edit it before approving.
learning.sp_stale: The skill changed since this proposal: approving will fail; propose it again.
learning.sp_made: Proposals created: {0}. Review them in "Proposed skills".
learning.sp_send_warn: The context will be sent to {0} to write the proposal (cap {1} €). Continue?
learning.sp_same_model: the same provider as the answer
learning.sp_dup: An identical proposal already existed (pending or rejected).
learning.lessons_hint: Rules you approve. Nothing activates itself: every proposal waits for your approval and is only created when you click a button.
learning.no_prices: No prices: paid AI proposals are blocked (Ollama is free).
learning.review_lbl: 👎 on {0} answers that used this lesson: review it
learning.proposed_ok: Proposal created; review it under "What I have learned".
learning.no_corrections: No corrections found in that conversation.
learning.skills_hint: agentskills.io-format skills. They live in your vault (skills folder); never downloaded from the Internet and their scripts are never run.
learning.trusted_hint: Marking a repo as trusted gives the agent working in it two things: the skills in <repo>/.agents/skills, and access to your connected apps (Gmail, GitHub, Slack…). It can read them; to write it needs your confirmation. Off by default.
learning.title: Learning
learning.subtitle: What you told ConductLoop about its answers. Everything stays on this computer.
learning.privacy_feedback: 👍/👎 ratings are always stored locally when you click them. They are never sent anywhere.
learning.failure_hint: Off by default. Stores error codes only (provider, model, kind), never questions, answers or notes. Deleted after 30 days; turning it off deletes everything.
learning.no_feedback: No ratings yet. Use 👍/👎 under Brain answers.
learning.import_skill_hint: Carpeta local con SKILL.md (formato agentskills.io). Se valida y se copia a tu vault. Los scripts nunca se ejecutan.
learning.import_url_hint: Solo direcciones https públicas: una carpeta de GitHub (tree o blob) o un .zip / .tar.gz. Se descarga a un área temporal, se valida, y no entra en tu vault hasta que apruebas. Los scripts nunca se ejecutan.
learning.url_scripts: Esta carpeta incluye scripts; se copiarán como ficheros y nunca se ejecutarán.
